purpose: Audit whether the stored worst-tail Top3 selections from the accepted 3-day research frontier were mechanically tradable under daily OHLCV, without recomputing returns or changing factor evidence.

scope.evidence_groups: Every evidence group bound by the frontier audit.
scope.factors: Every factor summary in each bound diagnostic; exactly 43 unique factors are expected.
scope.cohorts: The existing topk_tail_risk.worst_cohorts stored in each factor summary, with a maximum of five cohorts per factor.
scope.selections: Every stored selected_stocks member in each in-scope worst cohort; the registered TopK is three.
scope.sampling_limitation: This is a tail-sample execution audit. It does not estimate execution-event incidence across all historical selections.

quote_observations.adjustment_note: The local accepted economic-price chain is used. Same-session one-price equality and zero volume are invariant to the stored adjustment factors.

classifications.entry_missing_or_nonpositive_quote: Any missing or nonpositive entry OHLC value.
classifications.entry_nonpositive_volume: Entry volume is missing or nonpositive after a valid OHLC quote; zero volume makes the planned daily-bar fill mechanically impossible.
classifications.entry_one_price_upper_limit_like: Entry OHLC are equal and entry price divided by signal close minus one is at least 4.5%; daily data cannot establish queue priority or guaranteed fill.
classifications.exit_missing_or_nonpositive_quote: Any missing or nonpositive planned-exit OHLC value.
classifications.exit_nonpositive_volume: Planned-exit volume is missing or nonpositive after a valid OHLC quote; zero volume makes the planned daily-bar exit mechanically impossible.
classifications.exit_one_price_lower_limit_like: Planned-exit OHLC are equal and planned-exit price divided by the previous local session close minus one is at most -4.5%; daily data cannot establish queue priority or guaranteed fill.

threshold_rationale.description: The 4.5% threshold sits below the historical minimum 5% daily price limit applicable to risk-warning main-board shares during the development window. Requiring a one-price OHLC bar makes the label deliberately conservative and descriptive rather than an exact exchange-limit reconstruction.

interpretation.nonpositive_volume: Definite daily-bar execution impossibility at the planned session.
interpretation.one_price_limit_like: Queue-dependent execution ambiguity. It is not proof that the market had no trades or that an order could never fill.
interpretation.research_action: Do not change, promote, reject, aggregate, or rerun any factor from this audit alone.
interpretation.level2_action: Because no factor currently passes both frozen evidence gates, Level2 remains deferred even if queue ambiguity is observed.
interpretation.future_return_rerun: Any execution-corrected performance rerun requires a separate immutable preregistration and must be applied uniformly to all 43 factors and all evidence branches.

output_policy.experiment_output: Write an ignored machine-readable audit under data/experiments/short_horizon.
output_policy.tracked_summary: After the audit completes, freeze only aggregate counts, rates, compact examples, bindings, and conclusions into a tracked document.
